summary: Curated entry point for Kit's SillyTavern authoring knowledge. The collection covers portable and behaviorally significant content rather than installation, hosting, providers, or ordinary chat controls. Collection map routes character cards including sprites, chats and groups with JSONL versus TXT, World Info, personas and Data Bank, prompts and presets including CFG and reasoning, macro language semantics, an exhaustive pinned macro catalog, complete macro operators, regex and STscript automation, and an auditable source-coverage contract to focused pages, requiring whole-page reading around a search hit because prompt order, scope, and timing qualify isolated matches. Authority and provenance identifies independently organized Bunzai text, pins official SillyTavern-Docs commit 70e5e4d3c239253fca4692fe82e3936cb9c4b1b1 retrieved 2026-07-26 with the same pin as 2026-07-25, and preserves AGPL license and contributor links. How Kit should apply it separates upstream behavior, current adapter behavior, and authoring advice, making the format adapter page authoritative for implementation claims and forbidding invented adapter support from upstream alone. Refresh policy limits updates to content types, workflows, prompt contracts, or interoperability and requires revision comparison, regenerated semantic summaries, and independent review while excluding routine UI, install, and provider churn.

sections.title: Authority and provenance
sections.summary: Authority and provenance declares these pages independently organized Bunzai documentation rather than a verbatim mirror or upstream replacement. It pins SillyTavern/SillyTavern-Docs to commit 70e5e4d3c239253fca4692fe82e3936cb9c4b1b1 retrieved on 2026-07-26 (same pin as 2026-07-25), and states every page links its principal upstream sources. Upstream documentation is licensed under AGPL-3.0; Bunzai is also AGPL-3.0-or-later. Upstream copyright and contributor credits remain available in the official documentation repository, including its license file and LicenseCredits document. The pin, retrieval date, and attribution together make later audits and refreshes reproducible for Kit and maintainers.

sections.title: How Kit should apply it
sections.summary: How Kit should apply it requires distinguishing three claim kinds. Upstream behavior describes what SillyTavern does with a field or artifact. Bunzai format behavior describes what the current adapter can preserve or emit. Authoring advice explains how fields interact but does not prove every target format can carry them. For interoperability decisions, read this collection with the SillyTavern format page; if they differ, the format page governs current Bunzai implementation and this collection governs upstream meaning. Kit must never invent adapter support from an upstream feature description alone.

sections.title: Refresh policy
sections.summary: Refresh policy states SillyTavern evolves quickly. A future refresh should compare the pinned upstream revision, update only the affected Bunzai pages, regenerate their semantic sidecars, and obtain a new independent review. New upstream features should join this collection only when they change a content type, authoring workflow, prompt contract, or interoperability decision. Routine UI rearrangements, installation changes, provider lists, and transient defaults stay outside the collection. When exact current UI labels matter, follow the linked official page rather than treating this corpus as a live UI screenshot.
